author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the rise of age-verification hitting the brunt of Steam now and restricting future access to a store unless you start to give up your anonymity. This just another escalation at the same time numerous data breaches are happening revealing this captured information to those who have ill intent. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: They're Coming After Steam Now...
